description: This source file contains unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust class, specifically testing URL trust validation methods related to canvas actions within an Android application.

classes.name: CanvasActionTrustTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for CanvasActionTrust's URL trust validation functions.

methods.name: acceptsBundledScaffoldAsset
methods.description: Tests that a known scaffold asset URL is recognized as trusted.

methods.name: acceptsTrustedA2uiPageOnAdvertisedCanvasHost
methods.description: Tests that a specific trusted A2ui page URL on the advertised canvas host is accepted as trusted.

methods.name: rejectsDifferentOriginEvenIfPathMatches
methods.description: Ensures URLs with a different origin than the trusted one are rejected even if their path matches.

methods.name: rejectsUntrustedCanvasPagePathOnTrustedOrigin
methods.description: Verifies that pages outside the trusted path on a trusted origin are rejected.

methods.name: acceptsFragmentOnlyDifferenceForTrustedA2uiPage
methods.description: Checks that URL differences only in fragment are accepted if other parts match trusted URLs.

methods.name: rejectsQueryMismatchOnTrustedOriginAndPath
methods.description: Tests that URLs with mismatched query parameters are rejected despite matching origin and path.

methods.name: rejectsDescendantPathUnderTrustedA2uiRoot
methods.description: Ensures URLs pointing to descendant paths under the trusted A2ui root are rejected.
